meta.title: {appName}: Salah Tracker, Qaza, Zikr & Qur'an Practice App
meta.description: A free Islamic app with no ads: track your five daily Salah, make up Qaza, keep daily Zikr, and read, learn and practise the Qur'an with on-device AI.

hero.headline: <line>Track Your</line> <line>Journey</line> <accent>Back to Allah.</accent>

howItWorks.title: Up and running in a minute
howItWorks.intro: {appName} fits around the five daily Salah, so your routine and the app stay in step.

download.title: Download
download.text: Install on iPhone or Android, or open the web app. No account needed.

location.title: Set your location
location.text: Salah times appear for your city, with your method and madhab.

log.title: Log as you go
log.text: Tap each Salah and zikr. Your progress builds day by day.

privacy.title: Built for your worship, not for screen time
privacy.intro: Many Islamic apps are funded by ads or subscriptions. {appName} isn't, so it can stay calm, private and focused on helping you.

noAds.title: No ads
noAds.text: No ads, no subscriptions, no in-app purchases.

noAccount.title: No account needed
noAccount.text: Every personal feature works as a guest. Sign in to sync or to share with family.

private.title: Private by default
private.text: Your record stays on your device. Practice audio never leaves it.

offline.title: Works offline
offline.text: Tracking, the Qur'an text, adhkar and lessons need no signal.

sources.title: Authentic sources
sources.text: Qur'an, hadith and adhkar from established, credited datasets.

openSource.title: Open to inspect
openSource.text: The source code is public on {github}.

audiences.title: Wherever you're starting from
audiences.intro: Coming back to Salah, new to Islam, memorizing the Qur'an or teaching your children: see how the app fits.

compareGuides.compareText: Sourced, dated comparisons with other Islamic apps, including where they do better.
compareGuides.guidesText: Practical, cited guides on Salah, Zikr and the Qur'an, useful with or without the app.

aiPractice.title: Recite, and it follows along
aiPractice.description: An AI listener that runs on your phone follows your recitation word by word, so you can memorize and revise the Qur'an on your own, privately and for free.

follow.title: Follows you word by word
follow.body: Recite at your own pace. Words light up as the listener hears them, and words to try again are marked gently. No scores.

memorize.title: Built for memorization
memorize.body: Hide words or whole ayahs and recite from memory. Each word appears as you reach it, and you can tap any word to hear it.

revise.title: Revision that remembers
revise.body: Passages you practise come back for review after 1, 3, 7, 14, and 30 days, with an optional daily reminder.

private.title: Private by design
private.body: Your recitation is processed on your device. It is never recorded, stored, or uploaded. Only counts and ayah numbers are kept.

aiPractice.footnote: The listener is a one-time optional download (about 70 MB) on iOS, Android, and the web. It helps you practise; it is not a replacement for a teacher.
